record_title: Arbitrarily high starlike order does not force harmonic univalence
provenance: An explicit polynomial family of locally univalent sense-preserving harmonic maps shows that analytic parts of exact starlike order arbitrarily close to one still do not force global univalence.
limitations: The result rules out universal criteria based only on starlike order below one; additional hypotheses may restore univalence. Originality is assessed to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from differently parameterized literature and an uninspected 2009 Janowski-starlike paper. Independent audit has not been performed.
